summary.text: Oscar "Omar" Dantzler of Hammond is a Republican candidate who, according to the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide, is a retired police officer and owns a bail bonds business. He has run for office several times before, including as a Democrat for this same congressional seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Dantzler has also worked as a school bus driver in Tangipahoa Parish, according to the Louisiana Illuminator.
Dantzler ran for Louisiana governor in 2019, receiving 0.8% of the vote as a Democrat.
In 2022 he ran as a Democrat in the primary for Louisiana's 5th Congressional District and finished second with 15.7% of the vote, behind Rep. Julia Letlow.
He was listed as a Democratic candidate in the 2023 Louisiana governor's race but was among the withdrawn or disqualified candidates.

sources.title: Undeterred Democrats qualify for La. congressional races favoring GOP candidates
